title: CoroutinesInternalError & ClassCastException
body:
**Using Calf 6.1**

will update to latest 7.1 if maybe those were fixed since then (?)
From Sentry:

**CoroutinesInternalError:**
Fatal exception in coroutines machinery for DispatchedContinuation[FlushCoroutineDispatcher@50471de0, Continuation at com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker.FileSaverLauncher_desktopKt$rememberFileSaverLauncher$1$1$1.invokeSuspend(FileSaverLauncher.desktop.kt:24)@3983fb5c]. Please read KDoc to 'handleFatalException' method and report this incident to maintainers


**ClassCastException**
class kotlinx.coroutines.internal.Symbol cannot be cast to class com.mohamedrejeb.calf.io.KmpFile (kotlinx.coroutines.internal.Symbol and com.mohamedrejeb.calf.io.KmpFile are in unnamed module of loader 'app')
